MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WHERE p.position IN ['Frontcourt', 'Backcourt']
  AND CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) = 0
  AND CAST(p.draft_year AS INT64) > 2014
  AND CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) <> 2
RETURN p.position AS col1, MAX(CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64)) AS col2

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WHERE CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) = 0
  AND CAST(p.draft_year AS INT64) > 2014
  AND CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) <> 2
  AND p.position IS NOT NULL
WITH CASE
  WHEN p.position IN ['Center', 'Forward', 'Power Forward', 'Small Forward', 'Center-Forward', 'Forward-Center'] THEN 'Frontcourt'
  WHEN p.position IN ['Guard', 'Point Guard', 'Shooting Guard', 'Guard-Forward', 'Forward-Guard'] THEN 'Backcourt'
END AS position_group, p
WHERE position_group IS NOT NULL
RETURN position_group AS col1, MAX(CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64)) AS col2

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WHERE p.position IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) = 0
  AND CAST(p.draft_year AS INT64) > 2014
WITH CASE
  WHEN LOWER(p.position) IN ['frontcourt', 'center', 'forward', 'power forward', 'small forward', 'center-forward', 'forward-center'] THEN 'Frontcourt'
  WHEN LOWER(p.position) IN ['backcourt', 'guard', 'point guard', 'shooting guard', 'guard-forward', 'forward-guard'] THEN 'Backcourt'
END AS position_group, p
WHERE position_group IS NOT NULL
RETURN position_group AS col1, MAX(CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64)) AS col2

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WHERE p.position IN ['Frontcourt', 'Backcourt']
  AND p.nba_championships = '0'
  AND p.nba_championships <> '2'
  AND p.draft_year > '2014'
RETURN p.position AS col1, MAX(CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64)) AS col2
